issue.title: Route remote-row hijacks to the owner host instead of copying the command

task_type_fields.proposal:
Today `,k` on a remote fleet row redirects with `copy_remote_command`: the TUI copies `sase agent hijack NAME` and tracks a local referral (sase-1t2.12) so the mirror row shows "hijack requested on <alias>" until fleet facts report an outcome. The user still has to open a shell on the owner host and run the command.

Proposal: route the hijack request to the owner host (over the existing fleet/dispatch transport) and execute it there through the same v2 decision and stop/latch orchestrator, returning the hijack id, mode (immediate/latched/redirect/refused), and outcome to the requesting TUI. Recovery (Continue/Escalate/Dismiss) would follow the same route.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1t2 (Agent Hijack dependability, plan:202611/agent_hijack_dependability.md) explicitly deferred routed remote execution in its land phase; it needs an authenticated cross-host request path and owner-side admission design that the local custody epic did not cover. Proposed by the sase-1t2 plan's land phase (sase-1t2.14), which did not record it; filed by the sase-1t2 land agent.

issue.creation_reason: Deferred by epic sase-1t2's land phase and never recorded; the sase-1t2 land agent files it so remote hijack stays a tracked idea.
